answer: The patcher never throws a sail away: she cuts the good cloth out of the ruined sail and sews it into the next. Tar hemp hawser layer sail bond rules the cutting: a bond hemp hawser layers lodge after laying yard checks. The garden is the first cut salvaged, the umber the last before the cloth is sewn, and the comet is the sewing, the needle moving through old canvas. A forger would salvage 97 false cuts and sew 97 false seams.
